title: VAT filings
intro: Prepare XML for manual import into MOJE daně / EPO. A download is not a submission.
profileHint: For Czech sole traders. Confirm your registered identity, effective date and reporting frequency. Saving status also updates the profile’s VAT payer setting. Registration changes within a period require accountant review.
documentHint: Review classifications explicitly; historical records have no deduction decision.
metadataHint: Use the tax document and actual transaction facts. Tax metadata does not change the historical total:
scope: 2026 periods only. Domestic 21%/12%, EU B2B services (§ 9(1)) and domestic construction reverse charge (code 4). Ordinary documents with full or no deduction. Advances, corrections, partial deductions, imports, exempt supplies, goods transactions within the EU and other special regimes require accountant processing.
changed: Source data changed since the previous version.
unchanged: Source data matches the previous version.
firstVersion: No saved version for this period and form yet.
generate: Save new version and download XML
exportSaved: Version saved. Import and check the XML in EPO.
historyHint: Each saved version contains its original snapshot and exact XML. Downloads never mark a filing as submitted.
recordedHint: Enter the base and recorded tax for each rate. Do not recalculate supplier rounding. For reverse-charge purchases, enter the applicable Czech rate and zero supplier VAT.
getRate: Get CNB rate for tax point
breakdownSaved: Breakdown saved. Review the tax data again and save.

fields.taxPoint: Tax point / duty to declare date
fields.exchangeRate: CZK per EUR for tax reporting

options.nonpayer_domestic: Domestic transaction of a non-payer / identified person

issues.individual_only: Only Czech individual taxpayers are supported.
issues.status_conflict: VAT status differs from the company profile. Review and save the taxpayer settings.
issues.frequency: Choose a period matching the registered frequency. Identified persons use monthly periods.
issues.registration_period: Review the effective registration date. Changes within a period are unsupported.
issues.identity: Complete a valid taxpayer identity field.
issues.office: Choose a valid tax office and its branch.
issues.activity: Enter the current EPO CZ-NACE activity code.
issues.correction_workflow: This correction mode needs a submitted baseline and a correction workflow. Use EPO with your accountant.
issues.replacement_deadline: A replacement is valid only before the filing deadline. Confirm this when importing into EPO.
issues.draft_excluded: Draft invoice excluded; confirm that no tax point has occurred.
issues.cancelled_document: Cancelled documents need explicit correction handling. Resolve with your accountant.
issues.review_document: Confirm classification and deduction using the current document.
issues.special_document: Advances, corrective or other special documents are unsupported.
issues.tax_point: Enter the correct tax point within the confirmed registration.
issues.advance_payment: Payment precedes the tax point. Advance-payment accounting is required.
issues.unpaid_adjustment: An earlier deduction on an overdue unpaid invoice may require a § 74b adjustment. Accountant processing is required.
issues.unsupported_classification: Classify the transaction. Unsupported cases must be processed with an accountant.
issues.counterparty: Specify whether the counterparty is a business or consumer.
issues.eu_identity: EU services require an explicit EU country and recipient/supplier VAT ID, with recipient liability under § 9(1). Verify VAT registration.
issues.registration_required: Review registration as a payer or identified person before reporting EU services.
issues.eu_line_treatment: Change issued lines to EU B2B service treatment; domestic reverse charge is a separate treatment.
issues.domestic_country: Domestic classification requires an explicitly confirmed Czech counterparty.
issues.nonpayer_tax: This transaction or deduction conflicts with taxpayer status.
issues.reverse_identity: Domestic reverse charge requires both parties to be Czech VAT payers.
issues.reverse_code: Only domestic construction code 4 is supported. Confirm matching issued-line treatment and code.
issues.domestic_line_treatment: Domestic standard invoices must contain only ordinary taxable lines.
issues.unexpected_recorded_tax: Reverse-charge services must not contain supplier-charged VAT.
issues.exchange_rate: Confirm a positive CZK/EUR tax rate and tax-point conversion date.
issues.exchange_review: Verify the currency conversion against your VAT records, including supplier-stated Czech VAT where applicable.
issues.currency: Only CZK and EUR are supported.
issues.breakdown: Complete a valid recorded VAT breakdown.
issues.totals_mismatch: VAT breakdown must reconcile exactly to the stored base, tax and total.
issues.unsupported_rate: Only domestic 21% and 12% rates are supported. Classify zero/exempt supplies separately with an accountant.
issues.eu_rate: Only EU service purchases taxable at the Czech 21% rate are supported.
issues.receipt_date: Enter the actual date the tax document was received.
issues.deduction_decision: Explicitly choose full or no deduction. Partial deductions need accountant support.
issues.deduction_status: Only VAT payers may claim input VAT.
issues.claim_period: Choose a valid claim period, after tax-point and receipt conditions are met. Only 2026 entitlements are supported.
issues.reverse_claim_period: For reverse-charge purchases, only a full deduction in the same period as self-assessment is supported.
issues.no_deduction: No deduction requires zero deductible tax and an empty claim period.
issues.deductible_amount: Enter the full deductible amount in CZK; it must equal eligible recorded or self-assessed tax.
issues.document_number: Enter the supplier’s original document number (maximum 60 characters).
issues.cz_vat_required: A valid Czech VAT ID is required for this statement entry.
issues.reconciliation: Forms do not reconcile. Resolve the contributing documents before export.
issues.epo_check: XML is checked locally before export. This filing has not been checked by EPO: import, validate and review before manually submitting.
issues.xml_invalid: Official XSD validation failed. Check identity field lengths and document data.

reasons.no_activity: No filing of this type is indicated by the supported transactions.
reasons.nonpayer: Non-payer: no ordinary VAT filing. Special liabilities require accountant processing.
reasons.identified_no_kh: Identified persons do not file a control statement.
reasons.return_obligation: VAT payer periodic return, or identified person with tax liability.
reasons.domestic_or_acquisition: Reportable domestic transactions, deductions or acquisitions require a control statement.
reasons.eu_services: EU B2B services to VAT-registered recipients require a recapitulative statement.
